FIXED TERM EMPLOYMENT CONTRACT 
 
 This Fixed Term Employment Contract (the “ Contract ”) is entered into at [●city] on this [●date] day of [●month], [●year] . 
 
 BETWEEN 
 
 EMPG LABS (SMC-PRIVATE) Limited , a company incorporated under the laws of Pakistan and having its office at 8 th Floor, Mega Tower, 63-B, Main Boulevard, Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan (the “ Company ”) ; 
 
 AND 
 
 Mr./Ms. [●] daughter/son/wife of Mr. [●] resident of [●] having Computerized National Identity Card No. [●] (the “Employee” ). 
 
 (The Company and the Employee shall hereinafter collectively be referred to as the “ Parties ” and individually as the “ Party ” ) 
 
 
 WHEREAS, the Company is desirous of employing the Employee for a fixed term, and the Employee is willing to accept such employment, to undertake and perform the tasks and responsibilities of [ ● designation ] in accordance with the terms of this Agreement. 
 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows : 
 
 SCOPE OF EMPLOYMENT 
 
 Upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Contract , Company hereby engages and the Employee hereby accepts the engagement as [ ● designation ] , to provide and perform her/his duties in relation thereto , in a timely, expeditious, and professional manner, and in accordance w ith the terms of this Contract . 
 
 The Employee shall work under the s upervision of her/his line manager at the Company’s office located in [● city] with effect from the date first mentioned above . 
 
 This Contract shall commence on the Effective Date and shall remain in effect for a period of [ ● months/years ] or until earlier termination or modification of this Contract as per the terms hereof and in accordance with applicable laws (“ Period of Employment ”). 
 
 Standard working days for the Employee are from [ ● first working day ] to [ ● last working day ] (both days inclusive), wherein the Employee shall perform his duties from [ ● office/city ] or from such other locations as specified by the Company. The Employee shall endeavour, at all times, to remain available for fulfilling the requirements of a [ ● designation ] . Moreover, the Employee may, from time to time be required to perform his duties at locations other than [ ● office/city ] . 
 
 In the course of his duties, the Employee shall provide / perform inter alia the following duties and responsibilities: 
 
 to arrange and hold meetings with the relevant stakeholders; 
 to act as an intermediary and facilitator between the Company and the relevant stakeholders; and 
 to brainstorm strategies, propose solutions, mitigate conflicts, act as an intermediary between the Company and relevant stakeholders. 
 
 Whereas the aforementioned duties and responsibilities of the Employee outline the domain of the Employee’s assignments in general; however, the Employee shall perform and provide , from time to time, such other duties and responsibilities as may be required by the Company to meet the requirements of a [ ● designation ] . 
 
 RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE PARTIES 
 
 Employee is not an agent, representative, assign or nominee of the Company and shall not at any time during the Employment Period or after termination or expiry hereof , represent himself/herself as connected with the Company in any capacity. 
 
 Employee agrees that the Employee does not have the authority to act for or on behalf of the Company , to bind the Company in any respect whatsoever, or to incur any debts or liabilities in the name of or on behalf of the Company . 
 
 During the Employment Period or upon t ermination or expiry hereof , the e mployee shall not ipso facto be entitled to, demand or claim regular or permanent employment. 
 
 Company shall provide to the Employee such access to Company ’s resources, data and information, personnel, equipment, and property as may be reasonably required by the Employee in performance of his/her services , subject to Employee ’s confidentiality obligations hereunder. 
 
 Employee hereby assigns Company the right to monitor and record exchange of any communication, information, or data conducted by the Employee via Company's electronic systems. The Employee understands and acknowledges that the aforesaid consent is necessary for the purpose of: ensuring compliance with Company’s policies, as may be amended from time to time; preventing misuse of Company’s facilities, ensuring compliance with confidentiality obligations or any other term of this Contract . 
 
 REMUNERATION 
 
 In consideration of the Employee performing her/his duties and responsibilities as [ ● designation ] under this Contract , the Company shall pay to the Employee , during the Employment Period, such remuneration as has been listed in Annex ure A (“ Remuneration ”). 
 
 Notwithstanding anything contained in this Contract , tax liability, if any, shall be the exclusive responsibility of the Employee, and the Employee hereby authorizes the Company to make any tax withholdings, at any time, from his/her salary and benefits as may be required by law or local regulations. Similarly, if an obligation is placed by any other statute/law at any point of time on the Company to deduct from the Employee’s Salary and deposit as prescribed, the Company may do so. 
 
 The Salary shall be payable in arrears at the end of each month subject to such deductions, if any, as specified under the terms of this Contract. Withholding tax or any other applicable taxes shall be deducted from the Salary. 
 
 The Company shall be entitled to deduct from the Salary any money that is owed to the Company by the Employee at any time. 
 
 WARRANTIES AND REPRESENTATIONS 
 
 Employee represents and warrants to Company that he/she is under no contractual or other restrictions or obligations which are inconsistent with the execution of this Contract or which will interfere with the performance of his/her duties and responsibilities under this Contract . 
 
 Employee represents and warrants that all duties and responsibilities under this Contract shall be provided and performed by the Employee in a prompt and diligent manner, exercising professional skill and reasonable care, and at a level of proficiency and expertise that is reasonably expected of [ ● designation ] . 
 
 EMPLOYEE CODE OF CONDUCT 
 
 The Employee shall be bound at all times by the terms of the Company’s policies, rules and regulations, including the Company’s service rules and/or human resource internal policy , as may be made applicable and/or amended from time to time. 
 
 In addition to the obligations of the Employee herein contained, the duties of the Employee shall include all such duties as are normally expected of a [● employee’s designation] , for a business carrying on the activity of a real estate portal and other connected and related activities as set out in Recital (A). 
 
 The Employee shall, at all times, exercise reasonable professional skill and care in the performance of his/her duties, and shall comply with all applicable laws, including any duties implied by law 
 
 The Employee shall perform tasks and undertake responsibilities under the direction and supervision of her/his Line Manager and she/he will carry out the duties and assignments entrusted to her/him from time to time. 
 
 The Employee shall discharge her/his duties and responsibilities efficiently and diligently to the satisfaction of the Company and shall promote the interests of the Company. 
 
 The Employee shall strictly perform, observe and conform to such duties and instructions as communicated from time to time by the Company and shall not act in any manner contrary to the interests of the Company. 
 
 The Employee shall report any wrongdoing committed by her/him or any other employee to her/his immediate superior or Chief Executive Officer of the Company. 
 The Employee hereby gives consent to the Company to monitor and record the exchange of any communications, information or data through the Company's electronic systems. The Employee understands and acknowledges that the aforesaid consent is necessary for the purpose of ensuring compliance with Company policies, as may be amended from time to time, misuse of Company facilities, breach of confidentiality or any other term of this Contract. 
 
 The Employee shall be advised from time to time in writing of the extent and scope of her/his authority in dealing with third parties and shall work within the scope of such authority. In the absence of any specific express written authority, the Employee shall not make any binding commitment on behalf of the Company. 
 
 The Employee shall not, at any time, except in the case of illness, absent herself/himself from her/his duties without the prior written consent of the Company. In case of illness, the Employee shall inform the Company at the first opportunity and provide the Company details of any illness along with supporting materials, such as medical certificates and advice. 
 
 The Employee shall, at all times, both within and outside of working hours conduct herself/himself in a proper and fitting manner towards the Company and its customers and duly and properly observe, obey, comply with and adhere to, in all respects, all Company policies (as may be amended from time to time), local laws, rules and regulations for the time being in force. 
 
 The Employee shall not engage directly or indirectly in any other occupation during his/her Period of Employment. 
 
 The Employee shall n ot, at any time, make any untrue or misleading statement relating to the Company, and shall uphold the interests of the Company to the best of her/his ability and shall do nothing to prejudice such interests at any time, either during the Period of Employment or after termination/expiry hereof. 
 
 The Employee agrees that she/he shall keep the contents of this Contract confidential. 
 
 INVENTIONS &amp; INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS 
 
 The Employee hereby assigns to the Company all rights, including, without limitation, copyrights, patents, trade secret rights, and other intellectual property rights associated with any ideas, concepts, techniques, inventions, processes, works of authorship, Confidential Information or trade secrets: 
 
 conceived, developed or created by the Employee, solely or jointly with others, during his/her Period of Employment with the Company; 
 
 that the Employee conceives, develops, discovers or makes in whole or in part during his/her Period of Employment that relate to the Company or its affiliates, or the predecessors of any such entities, or the actual or anticipated research or development of the Company or any affiliate of the Company, or the predecessors of any such entities; 
 
 that the Employee conceives, develops, discovers or makes in whole or in part during his/her Period of Employment that are made through the use of any of the finances, equipment, facilities, supplies, trade secrets or time of the Company or its affiliates, or the predecessors of any such entities, or that result from any work the Employee performs for the Company or its affiliates, or the predecessors of any such entities; or 
 
 developed or created by the Employee, solely or jointly with others, at any time before the signing of this Contract, that relate to or involve the Company’s businesses (including, inter alia the business of the Company group, i.e. Emerging Markets Property Group (the “ Company Group ”). 
 
 (i), (ii), (iii) and (iv) above shall collectively be referred to as the  " Work Product " . 
 
 Without limiting the foregoing, to the extent possible, all software, compilations and other original works of authorship included in the Work Product will be considered a work made for hire. If, notwithstanding the foregoing, the Employee for any reason retains any right, title or interest in or relating to any Work Product, the Employee agrees promptly to assign, in writing and without any requirement of further consideration, all such right, title, and interest to the Company. Upon request of the Company at any time during or after the Employment Period, the Employee will take such further actions, including execution and delivery of instruments of conveyance, as may be appropriate to evidence, perfect, record or otherwise give full and proper effect to any assignments of rights under or pursuant to this Contract. The Employee will promptly disclose to the Company any such Work Product in writing. 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 The Employee shall not at any time, whether during the Period of Employment or after termination hereof for any reason whatsoever, disclose, divulge, make public, impart or make use of any Confidential Information for the use of the Employee or for any other purpose or to anyone other than as directed by or with the consent of the Company. 
 
 The Employee shall not, except in the proper course of her/his duties under this Contract, remove from the premises of the Company or copy or allow others to copy the contents of any document, computer disk, tape or other tangible item which contains any Confidential Information or which belongs to the Company, acquired directly or indirectly during the course of the employment. 
 
 For the purpose of this Contract, the term “ Confidential Information ” shall mean any which is not known to the public (including, without limitation, any information, content, letter, advice, email, fax, memorandum, contract, plans, report, presentations, research, analysis, summary, training materials or any other document, including all drafts thereof, whether in hard-copy or electronic file format or any other way of representing or recording information which contains or is derived or copied from such information) furnished by the Company in good faith under the reasonable belief or express instructions that it shall be in fact treated as confidential. It shall also include any written or verbal information relating to the business or the affairs of: 
 
 the Company, its subsidiaries, associated companies and affiliates; 
 
 clients of the Company, including any prospective client(s) of the Company, their subsidiaries, associated companies and affiliates; and/or 
 any company, firm or person with which the Company, its subsidiaries, associated companies or affiliates, may at any time be in commercial or technical co-operation or association; 
 
 For the sake of clarification and without in any way limiting the generality of the foregoing, it is specifically stated that the term “Confidential Information” shall include (i) business connections, client details, contracts, payment details, services packages; and (ii) Company’s strategy, business/investment/marketing plans and Company’s financial information. 
 
 The Employee acknowledges that by virtue of being an employee of the Company, she/he will, at a minimum, be provided and/or have access to Confidential Information relating to trade secrets, business connections, client details, contracts, payment details, services packages, Company’s strategy, business/investment/marketing plans and Company’s financials and said information has business and financial value to the Company and constitutes its trade secrets. In consideration of such provision or access, the Employee agrees that after termination/expiry of this Contract, she/he shall not disclose such trade secrets. 
 
 NON-COMPETITION &amp; NON-SOLICITATION 
 
 The Employee covenants that, during the Period of Employment and up to one year after termination/expiry of this Contract under Clause 10, or such other maximum period as may be permitted under law, she/he shall not, in the geographical area of Pakistan (the “Territory” ): 
 
 compete with the Company in any way whatsoever, directly or indirectly, including without limitation as a shareholder, owner, partner, employee, agent or consultant of another competing business; 
 
 shall not in any way whatsoever, directly or indirectly, give service, information or advice, or in any way become connected with any other company, firm or person engaged in the business similar to that being done by the Company, including those specified in Recital (A) or any business incidental thereto. This will specifically include the entities mentioned in Clause 7.2 below; 
 
 solicit or endeavour to entice away from or discourage any dealing with the Company by any person who was, at any time during the period of one year preceding the date of termination/expiry, a supplier, vendor, contractor, customer or client of the Company or endeavour to influence in any way the relationship between any supplier, vendor, contractor or employee and the Company, including any prospective supplier, vendor, contractor, client or customer of the Company, of which the Employee has knowledge, idea or awareness due to his employment; 
 
 supply or provide any goods or services to any person who was, at any time during the period of one year preceding the date of termination/expiry, a supplier, contractor, customer or client of the Company, including any prospective supplier, contractor or client of the Company, of which the Employee has knowledge, idea or awareness due to his employment; 
 
 recruit, solicit, induce or attempt to induce, any employee of the Company or its affiliates to terminate their employment with, or otherwise cease their relationship with, the Company or its affiliates, whether or not such person would be in breach of contract by reason of such termination; 
 
 take any action which is prejudicial to the name, business and/or trading position of the Company which would or could cause damage to the Company or any employee of the Company. 
 
 In this regard, the Employee specifically acknowledges and agrees that the aforementioned restrictive covenants shall apply in respect of the entities listed below (including their subsidiaries, associates, affiliates and any entities in which the same have any direct or indirect legal or beneficial interest or with which they have any strategic business relationships): 
 
 Property Finder FZ-LLC; 
 PakWheels (Private) Limited 
 Homes Pakistan; and 
 Alibaba Group Holding Limited 
 
 The Company is entitled at its sole discretion to add other entities to the above list and notify the same in writing to the Employee. Upon such notification, the additional entity(ies) shall be deemed to always have been part of this Clause. 
 
 In case the Employee is in breach of Clause 6 and/or 7, the Company shall be entitled to resort to all available legal remedies to enforce its contractual rights against the Employee and any person connected thereto and in particular, to seek injunction from a competent forum against the Employee or any other relevant person(s) for the effective enforcement of the aforementioned covenants. 
 
 The Employee fully understands and agrees to the covenants stated in Clauses 6 and 7 and acknowledges that in view of the applicable laws as interpreted by the Courts, the same are reasonable in order for the Company to protect its legitimate financial and business interests. 
 
 INDEMNIFICATION 
 
 Without prejudice to the rights under Clauses 8.2 and 8.3, in the event of breach or violation of Clauses 6 or 7, of the Contract, the Employee undertakes and hereby agrees to indemnify the Company, i.e. EMPG Labs (SMC-Private) Limited, for a minimum amount of PKR [●] (Rupees [●] ) ( the “Indemnity Amount ” ). 
 
 For payment of the Indemnity Amount, the Employee shall execute a promissory note in favor of the Company. 
 
 The Company shall also be entitled to recover and set off the Indemnity Amount from any amounts due to the Employee including end of service benefits. 
 
 The provision(s) of the promissory note and indemnification by the Employee is without prejudice to the rights of the Company under Clauses 8.2 and 8.3 above. Further, the Indemnity Amount is not by way of a cap and in case of any losses/damages/costs incurred or suffered by the Company in excess of the Indemnity Amount, the Employee shall remain liable for any such losses/damages/costs and the Company shall be entitled to recover the same through all available legal means. 
 
 CONFLICT OF INTEREST 
 
 At the time of signing of this Contract, the Employee declares and confirms that she/he has no obligations to any prior employer or other person or organization which may interfere with her/his performance at the Company, result in any conflict of interest for the Company, its affiliates or clients. The Employee further confirms that she/he has no commitments or restrictions as a result of past or present consulting agreements, directorships, ownership, or other position or connection with any other organization, and shall not enter into such commitments without prior approval of the Company. 
 
 The Employee agrees to disclose any matter urgently to the Company including matters relating to her/his family if it involves conflict of interest between her/his personal commitments and her/his obligations under this Contract. 
 
 The Employee shall not directly or indirectly accept any commission, rebate, discount, or gratuity, in cash or in kind, from any person, partnership or company who has or is likely to have any sort of relationship with the Company, its subsidiaries or associated entities. 
 
 
 TERMINATION 
 
 During the Probationary Period, the Company may terminate the Contract with or without cause with immediate effect by serving a notice of termination on the Employee. In such a case, the Company will not be obligated to pay the Employee any amount(s) including any Salary or compensation. 
 
 During the Period of Employment, either Party may terminate the Contract, without cause, by serving upon the other [● notice period] months’ notice in writing or, in lieu thereof, paying to the other an amount equal to [● notice period] month’s salary of the Employee. 
 
 The Company is also entitled to dismiss the Employee at any time without notice or payment in lieu thereof, if the Employee: 
 
 commits a serious breach of his/her obligations as an Employee; 
 
 the requirements of any regulatory body whose consent is required to undertake his/her appointment are not complied with; 
 
 ceases to be eligible to work in the Pakistan and/or is declared bankrupt. 
 
 is habitually late and absent without permission and is unable to provide a satisfactory explanation of the same or overstays leave without permission; 
 
 has other employment(s) which has not been disclosed to the Company at the time of execution of this Contract; 
 is incapacitated or is caught by any mental disease which undermines his/her capacity to perform his/her duties in Company; 
 
 is convicted of any criminal offence under Pakistan Penal Code, 1860 or any applicable law which carries imprisonment along with it; 
 
 ceases to hold professional qualification; or 
 
 in the reasonable opinion of Company, the Employee is found negligent and incompetent in performance of his/her duties or is guilty of any fraud or dishonest acts which are adverse to the interests of Company. 
 
 Nothing in this Clause shall prevent the Company from terminating the Contract in case of breach of the Employee. 
 
 The termination of the Contract shall not affect in any way the obligations of the Employee under Clauses 5, 6, 7 and 8 hereof which obligations shall continue to be fully binding on the Employee notwithstanding such termination. 
 
 The exercise of termination rights shall be in addition to, and not in substitution for, any other remedies that may be available to the Company and the exercise of such rights shall not relieve the Employee of the obligations incurred till the date of such termination, or relieve the Employee from liability and damages for breach of the Contract. 
 
 The rights of Company to terminate the Contract are without prejudice to any other rights that it might have at law. 
 
 On termination of the Contract, the Employee shall immediately (a) deliver to the Company all the documents, records, books, all documents pertaining to Confidential Information, information relating to business affairs, mobile phones, computer, and any keys, which are in the possession of Employee or under his/her control; and (b) delete all Confidential Information from any computer disks, tapes or other re-usable material in his possession or under his control and destroy all other documents and tangible items and properties in his possession or under his control, which contain or refer to any Confidential Information. 
 
 The Employee shall not at any time after termination, represent himself as connected with the Company in any capacity. 
 
 If upon or after the termination of employment for any reason whatsoever, the Employee is or becomes indebted to the Company in any sum or sums of money, the Company shall have the right to retain and set off against the amount of such indebtedness the whole or any part of the money then or thereafter becoming due to the Employee. The forgoing right shall be in addition and without prejudice to all other rights, powers and remedies of the Company to recover or obtain payment of the amount of such indebtedness. 
 
 
 
 
 NON-ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Employee shall not assign the benefit of the Contract to any third person and shall not delegate to a third person the duties to be performed by him under the Contract. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 
 In the event that any provision in the Contract should under applicable law be held illegal or void, such provision shall be considered severable and the remaining clauses and provisions shall continue in full force and effect. In such case, the Parties shall make every effort to replace the ineffective provision with a new provision which has the same effect, or as approximate effect as possible, as the said provision. If the Parties cannot agree to such new provision, either Party shall be entitled to terminate the Contract with immediate effect. 
 
 WAIVER 
 
 Failure of either Party to insist upon the strict and punctual performance of any provision herein shall not constitute a waiver of the right to require such performance, nor shall a waiver in one (1) case constitute a waiver with respect to a later breach whether of similar nature or otherwise. Nothing in the Contract shall prevent a Party from enforcing its rights by such remedies as may be available in addition to termination. 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 This Contract , along with Annexure A and all Company policies (as may be amended from time to time), constitutes the entire agreement between the Parties hereto with respect to the subject matter hereof and, upon its effectiveness, shall supersede all prior agreements, understandings and arrangements, both oral and written, between the Employee and the Company (or any of its affiliates) with respect to such subject matter. This Contract may be executed in two or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. This Contract may not be modified in any way unless by a written instrument signed by both the Company and the Employee. 
 
 EXCLUSIVE JURISDICTION 
 
 The Contract is made at [● city] and the Courts at [● city] shall have exclusive jurisdiction in respect of all matters arising under or pertaining to the Contract . 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 All notices required or contemplated under the Contract shall be given in writing by registered mail, acknowledgement due, to the following: 
 
 If to the Company: Company address stated above (courier or registered mail only) 
 
 If to the Employee: Employees address stated above (courier or registered mail only). 
 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF , the Company (by its duly authorized officer) and Employee, having fully understood the conditions set therein, of their own free will, have each caused this Agreement to be duly executed as of the day and year first above written.
